extracted.intended_audience: public relations, corporate communications, investor-relations professionals and organizations that issue press releases
extracted.subtask_short: distributing press releases via Business Wire
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and service-capability description for organizations using Business Wire to distribute full-text news releases, regulatory filings, photos and multimedia to journalists, financial professionals, regulators and the public worldwide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmit full-text news releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire transmits full-text news releases, regulatory filings, photos and other multimedia content to journalists, financial professionals, investor services, regulatory authorities and the general public worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete, final full-text releases (including any required regulatory language) to ensure Business Wire can distribute to its comprehensive news and disclosure network and downstream partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfy regulatory disclosure obligations via dedicated filing services
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire offers services for satisfying regulatory obligations in the US and around the globe. Our in-house EDGAR team - an industry first - makes Business Wire the largest EDGAR filer in the newswire sector. Business Wire also offers Canadian SEDAR and UK Regulatory filings, along with disclosure fulfillment in Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Sweden and Switzerland.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Business Wire's specialized filing teams (EDGAR, SEDAR, UK filings, and European disclosure services) when the announcement must meet regulatory filing requirements; ensure submissions conform to the jurisdictional formats and timelines required for disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target distribution using industry- and topic-specific networks
rubrics_metrics.description: In the US, our Business Wire, AutomotiveWire, EntertainmentWire, HealthWire and SportsWire networks offer more than 200 industry segments to provide highly targeted news delivery to relevant audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the appropriate Business Wire network or industry segment (e.g., AutomotiveWire, HealthWire) to reach the most relevant journalists and audiences rather than broadcasting generically; use issue-specific circuits like CSR Circuit or Public Policy Circuits for specialized topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use demographic and issue-specific circuits for audience targeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire provides services for issue-specific news such as corporate social responsibility and public policy with our CSR Circuit and Public Policy Circuits. Demographic markets include Hispanic, African and Asian American.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When targeting specific demographic or issue-based audiences, route releases through the appropriate circuit to maximize relevance and pickup by outlets serving those communities or policy areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include multimedia using the Smart News Release platform
rubrics_metrics.description: Via Business Wire's exclusive Smart News Release platform, text news releases and multimedia content are posted online and distributed to key audiences via the Business Wire network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach photos, video, and other multimedia assets to take advantage of Smart News Release distribution and increased visibility online and to partner outlets; ensure multimedia meets Business Wire technical/spec requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Photo Smart News Releases for photo distribution to key outlets
rubrics_metrics.description: Photo Smart News Releases are posted directly to Yahoo! Finance, distributed to daily newspapers in the US via the Associated Press photo network and posted to community and industry-based websites. Smart News Release also offers photo distribution to newspapers and media in the UK, Europe and Asia via leading photo agency partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit high-quality photos with proper captions/credits to enable placement on Yahoo! Finance, AP photo feeds and international photo agency networks; this increases chances of placement in print and online media globally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure and monitor distribution and impact with NewsTrak
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire's suite of measurement and monitoring services, NewsTrak, provides news release distribution statistics, website posting reports, online viewership data, media clips, media intelligence, reputation management and analytics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use NewsTrak to track distribution reach, viewership, media pickups and to gather analytics for evaluating release performance and informing future targeting and content decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage trade show and conference partnerships for added exposure
rubrics_metrics.description: Our trade show and conference division ... by working with leading industry shows and financial conferences, including having Official Wire status at dozens of them, we provide unique additional exposure for our members' news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate release timing and content with trade show or conference activity and use Business Wire's Official Wire partnerships to gain event-specific distribution and visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer providers with extensive local newsrooms and personalized service for accuracy and turnaround
rubrics_metrics.description: With more newsrooms than any other commercial newswire, Business Wire provides better local support with fast turnaround of your news releases and greater accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a distributor that offers localized newsroom support and personalized customer service to improve accuracy, responsiveness, and speed of distribution—especially for time-sensitive or localized announcements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rely on full-text carriage partnerships for broad media pickup
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire is the only commercial newswire that has full-text carriage provisions with all of the world's leading news organizations: Agence France-Presse, Associated Press, Bloomberg, Dow Jones and ThomsonReuters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using a service with full-text carriage agreements increases the likelihood that releases will be ingested and displayed fully by major global news organizations; ensure release content is formatted appropriately for such partners.
